description: Ads Lighthouse is a managed service for monitoring Google and Bing brand-search ads by keyword, location, device, and time. It stores observed ads and related search context so marketing, SEM, and affiliate-compliance teams can review competitors, affiliates, and policy issues.
summary: Ads Lighthouse exposes two developer integration surfaces on adslighthouse.com: a bearer-token REST API at `https://adslighthouse.com/api/v1` and a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://adslighthouse.com/api/v1/mcp`, with MCP supporting OAuth sign-in and, on higher plans, API-key bearer auth.
